title: Rejected overclaim: benchmark to general intelligence and safety
japanese_title: ベンチマークから汎用知能・安全性を断定する過剰主張を拒否
summary: A 90% benchmark score is asserted as general intelligence and deployment safety.
user_input: Model X scored 90% on Benchmark B, so it is generally intelligent, safe, and reliable in real-world deployment.
reason_for_tier: Rejected: benchmark result lacks contamination check, reproduction status, transfer evidence, and safety evaluation.
audit_notes: This case keeps the source claim separate but rejects the overextended inference.
key_warning_theme: Benchmark score alone is used for general intelligence, safety, and deployment reliability.
